goal: Build the navmesh from the collision geometry that should stop NPCs.
queries: NPC walks through a wall in a GLB
clickable glass blocks NPCs
бот проходит сквозь стену из GLB
невидимый физический коллайдер
requirements: GLB with a visible glass mesh and an invisible *_collider mesh
GltfContainer physics and pointer masks
node: Decode distinct render and physical triangle sets from the supplied GLB. Check wall clearance and compare the direct, detour and disconnected routes.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → GLB collision masks. Observe actual SDK physics and pointer raycasts.
expect: Pointer rays hit the visible glass and physics rays hit the separate collider. The bot route clears the full collider footprint.
control: Swap the mesh classification and detect a route crossing the actual collider. Reject a corner cut even when its endpoints are outside the wall. Closing the bypass makes the goal unreachable.

goal: Rebuild a cached navmesh only when navigation inputs materially change.
queries: stale bake after editing scene
NPC uses old GLB geometry
устаревший навмеш после изменения модели
requirements: Offline asset import and canonical physical geometry fingerprint
node: Run the catalogue. Compare a material-only edit, a collider edit and a moved instance under the same asset name.
sdk7: Offline catalogue example. The fixture exercises an in-memory cache keyed by the physical geometry and bake settings.
expect: Cosmetic edit keeps the bake. Geometry and effective transform changes invalidate it and refresh the route.
control: Cache by file path alone and observe the stale route. Hash raw asset bytes and observe the needless rebuild on repaint.

goal: Assign a destination on the clicked deck.
queries: NPC picks the wrong floor when I click
same XZ targets different height
клик сверху ведёт бота на нижний этаж
requirements: Two stacked floor targets
SDK raycast hit with a zone key and Y
node: Feed deterministic ray hits into the same destination adapter and check the route's destination floor.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → Click destination on stacked floors. Scripted SDK rays simulate pointer selection from fixed camera positions.
expect: Upper and lower hits select different decks at the same XZ.
control: A hit on a non-target or a miss preserves the previous target. Flattening Y would misclassify the upper hit.

goal: Use a cheap shortcut only when it reaches the intended surface.
queries: navmesh raycast goes through a balcony
overlapping floor false positive
бот срезает под балкон вместо подъёма
requirements: Stacked walkable surfaces with an alternative ramp
Target polygon projection
node: Run the upper, lower and wall variants of the catalogue case.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Navmesh ray on two floors, with live navcat queries and deterministic follower playback.
expect: Reject the horizontal shortcut to the upper polygon and use the ramp. Accept the lower shortcut when unblocked.
control: A wall blocks the same-floor shortcut even when the target polygon is on the correct deck.

goal: Wait where the moving door leaf cannot hit the NPC.
queries: door hits waiting bot halfway through opening
safe door waiting spot
дверь задевает бота в точке ожидания
requirements: Swept hinge geometry
Waiting pocket or alternate lane
node: Run the safe pocket, physically disconnected pocket and unsafe endpoints variants.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Door sweeps the waiting point, with live navcat queries and an analytic controller.
expect: A reachable pocket stays clear during the swing. If removing its floor disconnects it, the native route search chooses the alternate lane.
control: Checking only the open and closed angles leaves a location inside the swept leaf. Remove the pocket floor to exercise real route fallback.

goal: Change NPC height to enter a low passage and stand up only after clearing it.
queries: NPC needs to crouch under a beam
agent stands too early after a tunnel
бот встаёт под низкой балкой
requirements: Standing and crouching clearance profiles
Capsule front and rear clearance checks
node: Run enabled, disabled, too-low and wrong-floor variants with both engines. Check the observed capsule movement in three dimensions.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Stand, crouch, stand, with live navcat queries and an analytic controller.
expect: Crouch before reaching the beam, clear it with the whole body, then stand. Return to the standing profile at the goal.
control: Disable crouch, lower the roof below crouching height or inject a route with a roof waypoint. The controller detects invalid support or clearance and takes the standing bypass.

goal: Follow each waypoint in order when an SDK system receives a long delta.
queries: NPC skips a corner on a slow frame
бот срезает два поворота при длинном кадре
requirements: Static L-turn corridor with two bends, authored waypoints, fixed speed, injected long delta
node: Compare one long update with equivalent short updates against the same swept-capsule oracle.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Two turns in one long frame. Scripted movement and swept geometry checks.
expect: Both updates traverse the two bends in order without crossing the wall.
control: Advance directly along the chord between endpoints. The swept check detects the cut.

goal: Intercept a moving NPC by predicting a reachable future position on another floor.
queries: chase NPC upstairs around a nearer ramp
перехватить патруль на другом этаже
requirements: Two levels with separate ascents and a known patrol schedule
node: Compare predictive, reactive and stationary variants using native navmesh routes.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Intercept a patrol upstairs. Routes use navcat where applicable. The scene shows the authored controller and its checks.
expect: Take the nearer ascent and reach the upper meeting point by the time limit.
control: Chase the current position and miss the moving target. A stationary target should stay a lower-floor goal.

goal: Choose a route whose intermediate positions stay out of an observer's direct line of sight.
queries: avoid a camera along the whole route
маршрут под укрытием, видимость только на середине пути
requirements: Two comparable routes, an observer, an opaque screen and explicit exposure checks
node: Compare covered, unobserved and no-cover variants. The controller evaluates geometric visibility along the candidate paths.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Find a route with cover. Routes use navcat where applicable. The scene shows the authored controller and its checks.
expect: Choose the covered route when required. Choose the shorter route when the observer is absent.
control: Remove the screen while keeping the observer. Reject both routes when each has an exposed segment.

goal: Account for conveyor velocity when evaluating movement direction and available paths.
queries: NPC runs in place against a conveyor
бот застревает на реверсивном конвейере
requirements: A moving surface with known velocity, an agent speed cap and an optional bypass
node: Compare forward, reversed, stopped and no-bypass variants.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Reversible conveyor. Routes use navcat where applicable. The scene shows the authored controller and its checks.
expect: Switch the viable direction when the belt reverses. Take the bypass if the belt cannot be overcome.
control: Without a bypass, report the opposing direction as unreachable. Stopping the conveyor restores both directions.

goal: Pick a station where a rectangular NPC can rotate its whole footprint.
queries: rectangular robot clips the corner while turning
длинный робот задевает стену при развороте
requirements: Rectangular footprint, two turning bays and an analytic swept-rotation check
node: Compare the wider station, narrow-only fixture and circular footprint control.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Gameplay → Turn a long robot at a station. Routes use navcat where applicable. The scene shows the authored controller and its checks.
expect: Use a station with enough space for the full turn and reach the requested heading.
control: Both axis-aligned poses fit the narrow bay but the rectangular rotation collides. A small circular footprint fits.

goal: Sample reproducible patrol points within an actual radius on a reachable floor.
queries: patrol picks a point outside its circle or on another floor
патруль выходит за заданный радиус или уходит на другой этаж
requirements: Stacked floors, reachable polygons, isolated room and controlled random seed
node: Sample using the nearest start ref and validate distance, layer and reachable route for accepted points.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Patrol on one floor. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: Every accepted point stays within the circle, on the chosen layer and reachable. Reusing the seed reproduces the series.
control: A long eligible polygon can produce a raw sample outside the radius. Excluding the final distance check exposes it.

goal: Extract waypoints for area events and detect a truncated output path.
queries: waypoint buffer cut off the goal; area crossings missing
буфер обрезал путь, где граница области
requirements: A complete corridor with area changes and a same-area portal
node: Compare plain, area-crossing, all-crossing and capped straight-path extraction with named options.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Area and portal crossings. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: Area mode reports transitions between areas. All-crossings adds a same-area portal. Only a path reaching the endpoint is complete.
control: A short output buffer retains a full corridor but loses the endpoint.

goal: Mark a runtime cost change on the intended floor without bleeding into the deck above.
queries: a hazard on the floor affects the balcony too
пролив на нижнем этаже меняет маршрут по верхнему
requirements: Overlapping upper and lower corridors, floor-specific volume and alternate route
node: Query candidate polygons and exact-filter the intended layer before applying a cost change.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Spill on the lower floor. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: Only the lower covered polygons change. The lower NPC uses an alternative and the upper route stays unchanged.
control: Widen the query vertically without checking layers. This change incorrectly reaches upper polygons.

goal: Choose the correct traversal action when multiple links share endpoints.
queries: wrong animation for two links at the same position
два off-mesh перехода совпадают по координатам, но выбирается не то действие
requirements: Two same-endpoint links with different flags, keys and compatible NPC profiles
node: Query from each profile and resolve the traversed link identity instead of inferring it from coordinates.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Coincident off-mesh actions. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: The same endpoints produce different action keys according to the NPC profile, including after registration order changes.
control: Dispatching by nearest coordinates picks the same action for both profiles.

goal: Tune the region filter so an essential intermediate landing survives bake.
queries: a small landing disappeared after baking
маленькая посадочная площадка исчезла из навмеша
requirements: Two outer platforms, an intermediate landing and two authored transitions
node: Bake below and above a region threshold and test the refs and route separately.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Keep the intermediate landing. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: The lower threshold preserves the intermediate polygon and enables the two-hop route.
control: Increasing the threshold removes the intermediate surface. Removing just the links preserves it but leaves the route disconnected.

goal: Temporarily steer a crowd agent by velocity, then give it a new path target.
queries: temporarily steer a crowd NPC and resume a route
ручная скорость агента crowd с возвратом к цели
requirements: One crowd with an active agent, side pocket and two goals
node: Use native target, velocity, reset and explicit zero-velocity hold in a persistent crowd.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Crowd velocity override. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: The agent moves through the pocket, holds position after reset and a zero-velocity command, and reaches the replacement goal.
control: Compare no lateral override, no reset, and reset without the zero-velocity hold. Record drift during the stop window.

goal: Use different access filters for agents moving on the same geometry and in one crowd.
queries: two agents in one crowd need different access flags
разные права прохода у NPC в одном crowd
requirements: Two alternate access lanes, two agents and individual filters
node: Compare two policies in one crowd, then swap them. Use engine-specific filter and projection adapters.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Crowd access policies. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: Each agent takes only its allowed lane, and the paths swap when permissions swap.
control: Sharing one filter incorrectly sends both agents down the same allowed lane.

goal: Inspect the local border a specific NPC sees through its access filter.
queries: debug forbidden portal as a wall for one character
проём виден как стена только конкретному NPC
requirements: A shared doorway and two access filters
node: Use navcat's wall segment query or pass --detour-wasm=<built-wasm-compat.js> to test the optional Detour binding on the same fixture.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Portal or wall by NPC. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: The same edge is a wall or a portal depending on the NPC filter.
control: A shared permissive filter reports the doorway as open for both agents.

goal: Prune unreachable polygons while preserving all valid spawn regions and directed connections.
queries: pruning removed my second spawn or kept an unreachable upper island
отсечение островков потеряло второй спавн
requirements: Two legal spawn seeds, a decorative island and one-way links
node: Run native directed reachability or pruning and validate nearest-poly candidates under the normal query filter.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Navigation APIs → Prune islands from two spawns. Native navcat query or crowd simulation with visualization of its result.
expect: Keep both legal spawns and the reachable landing. Ignore decorative polygons unreachable from either seed.
control: Omitting a legal seed loses its valid region. Treating links as bidirectional keeps an unreachable island.

goal: Import mirrored nested meshes while preserving walkable ramps.
queries: mirrored glTF ramp stops routing
зеркальная вложенная рампа исчезает из навмеша
requirements: Nested GLB transforms, one and two negative axes, instance poses and a flat reference
node: Read the fixture GLB and compare transformed geometry and route heights with manually expanded ramps.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → Mirrored GLB ramp. Open the synthetic GLB fixture and verify supports with SDK7 raycasts.
expect: Both composed transforms preserve the expected ramp and floor height.
control: Leave the reflected winding unchanged or flip both instances. The reference detects the lost or incorrectly oriented support.

goal: Resolve patrol points from stable scene entity names and parent-relative transforms.
queries: named markers stable after reordering
маршрут по именованным маркерам в Scene Editor
requirements: Named entities on two floors and author-controlled order
node: Run the marker fixture with changed creation order and with missing marker input.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → Named patrol markers. The fixture looks up real named SDK7 entities and composes their scene poses.
expect: Patrol order, marker identity and floor remain stable under creation-order changes.
control: Remove an expected name. Report the missing marker rather than using stale IDs or another floor.

goal: Restrict NPC routes to an authored non-rectangular parcel footprint while preserving shared seams.
queries: NPC shortcuts across missing parcel
бот срезает через отсутствующий parcel
requirements: Three parcels with a missing quadrant and aligned seams
node: Compare the clipped navigation geometry with a bounding rectangle and a relocated origin.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → L-shaped parcel bounds. The lab shows a scaled logical parcel layout within one physical parcel.
expect: The NPC stays in the union of the allowed parcels and crosses the valid seams.
control: A bounding box admits a shortcut through the cutout. Eroding parcels in isolation breaks the valid seams.

goal: Drive an in-place clip from observed speed while leaving world motion to the follower.
queries: NPC animation moves the transform twice
анимация NPC не совпадает с остановкой или скоростью
requirements: GltfContainer and Animator on a separate visual entity, visible start/stop route
node: Run the shared locomotion and animation contract with the debug control for displacement.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → Locomotion drives in-place animation. Watch the real Animator change between idle and walk as the route follower moves and stops.
expect: Animation follows actual motion and the gameplay root follows the same route with animation enabled or disabled.
control: A clip with root displacement or an animation state inferred from requested speed is detected by its respective check.

goal: Retain the destination and revalidate navigation when a hidden scene resumes.
queries: NPC teleports after opening and closing Explorer map
бот перескакивает закрытую дверь после закрытия карты Explorer
requirements: ExplorerUi map lifecycle events, changed door revision, bounded catch-up logic
node: Inject a hidden interval, a door update and a long resume delta while native route queries use the new mesh.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → Resume after fullscreen UI. Click Open Explorer map in the recipe panel, keep it open briefly, then close it.
expect: The visible NPC resumes toward the same goal with a current route and bounded movement.
control: Resume along the old route with the accumulated delta and detect it crossing or ignoring the changed door.

goal: Carry a reproducer from an Explorer log into a headless run using stable scene keys.
queries: replay Explorer NPC navigation bug in CLI
перенести лог навигационного бага из Explorer в CLI
requirements: Versioned navigation trace, fixture fingerprint, stable actor keys and ordered events
node: Run pnpm exec tsx scripts/recipe-creator-behavior-replay.ts <trace-or-log-path> with a captured JSON file or Explorer log.
sdk7: Creator recipes → SDK7 authoring → Record an Explorer navigation replay. Choose the recording example and copy its tagged trace from the Explorer scene log.
expect: Headless replay reproduces the same relevant events despite changed runtime entity IDs.
control: Reject traces with a stale geometry fingerprint, unsupported format or invalid event order.

goal: Stage validated tiles and publish a complete navigation snapshot atomically.
queries: partial navmesh import breaks old routes
при неудачном импорте часть новой карты ломает текущую сцену
requirements: One active snapshot, a candidate with an invalid tile, and a repaired rebuild
node: Import genuine tile artifacts into a separate candidate and record import/setup and queries.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Runtime operations → Recover from a failed import. Inspect the navcat snapshot used after a failed import and after the repaired retry.
expect: A failed candidate preserves the active revision and usable route. The repaired candidate publishes together.
control: Expose partial staged state and observe a route assembled from inconsistent revisions.

goal: Evict tiles and retire references as the navigation window travels repeatedly.
queries: navmesh streaming memory grows each lap
при повторных обходах растёт число загруженных тайлов
requirements: Overlapping loading windows, hundreds of tile transitions and bounded application ownership
node: Record tile count, stale references, phase durations and process memory counters. Treat memory samples as diagnostics.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Runtime operations → Bound tile streaming. The native navcat fixture tracks tile residency as the window moves. Process memory counters are available in Node.
expect: Resident tile count is bounded and retired route references become invalid.
control: Disable eviction or retain obsolete ownership. The independent residency or reference check detects the growth.

goal: Prioritize a route invalidated by a changed door within a bounded work queue.
queries: urgent route starves while many NPCs replan
срочное перепланирование теряется в фоновой очереди
requirements: Backlogged queries, an urgent route on a new revision and a deterministic per-tick work quota
node: Compare FIFO and bounded priority scheduling while native queries perform the work.
sdk7: Creator recipes → Runtime operations → Schedule urgent replans. Watch the urgent and background work advance with navcat routes in the same scene.
expect: The urgent route completes promptly, stale results are discarded and background work also advances.
control: FIFO misses the urgent latency target. The priority variant must also show background completion while urgent work is queued.
